g.text: Secondary analyses of two published plant systems | aggregate estimates and 95% intervals
A: female flower count, above-ground biomass and array adjusted. Pooled interval: 1,999 whole-mother resamples within arrays;
array-specific intervals: mother-level HC3, with shared female-count and biomass coefficients. No flower-number intervention was fitted.
B: 10,000 whole-flower resamples within arms; estimated selfing fractions and delta = 0.95 held fixed. Assignment and finite-seed
uncertainty are not propagated. Neither panel measures offspring survival or individual floral construction biomass.
